import pandas as pd

# Read the input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Compute missingness for each indicator
missingness_data = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    missingness_data.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': int(missing_count),
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create the missingness report
missingness_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_data)
missingness_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Select only kept indicators
kept_indicators = [col for col in indicator_cols if df[col].isna().sum() / len(df) <= 0.30]

# Create the selected matrix with city_id, city_name, year, and kept indicators
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
